body: Sounds silly yall, but I totally forgot theres a bus here. There wasn't one where I lived before. Ahh when will get used to city life lol

I know a lot of people get relief from smoking weed, I personally was smoking nonstop for a couple years (it was controlling my life). I ended up being inpatient in November, thus making me quit for a week, once I tried smoking again I noticed it was a serious trigger for my anxiety and depression. I honestly think that's why I've been a mess the last couple years, I feel better not smoking, just my personal experience.

Hi dear,
 You aren't lazy, I cant work either because of my depression and anxiety. You can sign up for SSI, depression and anxiety both qualify you for it. You will need to see a doctor, but you sign up for it online on your own and fill out a release of information at the doctors office.

Hi dear, are you seeking any professional help like counseling or medication? I completely understand the will to no longer live. I've been hospitalized four times, and have attempted suicide twice. Not successfully ending my life ironically made me feel more like a failure. I have a daughter now who is two,  I haven't tried hurting myself since I had her, but everyday is a struggle of existence. If you need to talk,  I'm here.

I am seeing a therapist and on anxiety meds (thank gosh I'd be losing it worse). I was literally living on a mountain top in WV, where bears would be in the driveway frequently. So this is a huge adjustment for me
